title: Trailer model
current_gap: The trailer is uncovered; towing/joint articulation and scene-coupled conditions are missing.

atoms.name: towing_joint_model
atoms.required: Towing hitch/joint articulation model with angle limits and coupling forces

atoms.name: scene_coupling_conditions
atoms.required: Scene-coupled conditions (slope, obstacle, turn) with expected responses

atoms.name: host_vehicle_dependency
atoms.required: Declared host vehicle identity; a trailer never runs standalone

atoms.name: non_coverage_rule
atoms.required: Rule enforced: single-vehicle evidence never covers articulated towing

scope_rule: a trailer is defined by its joint to a host vehicle and scene coupling; standalone vehicle evidence never substitutes
